children: Yum! Brands Inc. (YUM) filed a Form 8K - Director, Officer or Compensation Filing - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 01, 2026.

Aaron Powell, the Chief Executive Officer of the Pizza Hut business of Yum! Brands, Inc. (the "Company"), resigned from his position as Pizza Hut CEO and all other positions with the Company effective September 1, 2026, in connection with the closing of the Pizza Hut Transaction (as defined below).
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1041061/000104106126000187/yum-20260901.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1041061/000104106126000187/0001041061-26-000187-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
